resources.string: Subscribe to a channel, then choose Automatic channel downloads in its menu. New uploads are checked hourly, with up to 3 per channel and 20 total per check. Uses your default download quality and saved folders. Existing uploads are skipped; failed downloads can be retried from Downloads.
